Company ownership percentages are not portfolio weights. Each confirmed row has at least two independent publishing domains; three original NSE files were independently retrieved; most others have provider-only evidence, and each row shows its evidence level. Dates differ by company; September disclosures remain incomplete. June holdings are retained with their original dates. Same-date named vehicles are summed only with an explicit breakdown. Historical holdings below the 1% disclosure threshold, unlisted investments, and uncorroborated single-domain records cannot be fully observed. Missing names do not prove sales. Review rows withhold percentages and quantities rather than inventing a current holding. Older Growth Fund-1 and Diversified Alpha Fund-2 entries are not carried forward as current holdings without corroborated dates; recent anchor and bulk-deal purchases alone do not establish a current portfolio. SRIT India, Adroit Industries, Bai-Kakaji Polymers and Anawil Wire were found in ownership/deal searches but not added as confirmed current holdings because a matched legal-holder/date/percentage basis was not independently corroborated.
